name: Koan e2e test helper
description: scripts/e2e/lib/mac.mjs askTestHelper(): what synthetic keys and UI DevTools can't reach on macOS (the main menu, native context menus), for the 127.0.0.1 page that asks: close its window (chrome.windows.remove, which runs BrowserView::Close like the Close Window menu item), pin its tab, unload (discard) the tabs showing given URLs, close tabs by id, show a tab by its URL, list its window's tabs. The key fixes the id.
